scope: GSC BG and object state machines, command VM, BG presenter, arithmetic and identifier orders. No launcher, game assets, ROM bytes or player state copied.
modifications: BgEffects arithmetic dependency uses Gen2AnimMath instead of the full reference object pool.
A missing jump-table list resolves through edition-specific Gen2BgEffectIds for older native caches.

Existing Gen2AnimPlayer dispatches BG/palette commands and steps the pool from its current VM update. Native scene and picture owners consume these registers directly, replacing the legacy SE approximations.
BG presenter uses native palette/chrome/canvas owners, supports the real wide surface, preserves transparency and restores graphics state on supplied-panel errors.

Battler resize, hide, palette and lifted-row drawing remain attached to native image owners. The genuine object pool and command VM now drive native OAM; complete send-out event sequencing remains separate work.
The BG-only paper and clipping subset uses the native indexed palette owner, without requiring the full menu Chrome module on older engines.
Full object pool uses the already pinned native Gen2AnimMath sine/cosine subset. Native imported numeric animation tables are converted without inventing ROM programs or changing their operands.

Existing native animation player now uses the complete command interpreter and object pool as its sole clock. The native view consumes emitted OAM through the actual loaded GFX dictionary; no interpolated motion, 48-frame age cap or 16-frame drain remains.
The native importer preserves the crossed battler-row macro/handler names. A Gen2-only cache revision rejects old generated commands and preserves game saves.
